dedupe_keys.name: data resulting from the study of travel time from different points in amsterdam to urban commons

description: TU Delft provides travel times from origin locations in Amsterdam to Urban Commons associated with the DeMeent platform. The native description specifies origins at centroids of 2,241 hexagons covering Amsterdam. Walking, cycling, public transport and driving are the listed modes. CSV is the stated format. The source describes outputs of a socio-spatial accessibility study. Coverage: A complete source observation interval is unstated. Access: public native metadata identifies this release and its stated formats. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current distribution access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The observations are distinct from separately deposited code that generates transit-time inputs for Material Accessibility Analysis. The exact study date, destination list, travel-time units and current service schedules are unstated. No travel-time tables were acquired or recalculated. Its simulation use concerns the stated multimodal transport accessibility outputs.
